title: Canonical exact restriction of completed coefficient towers
statement: Fix a purity datum $P$ [def-pur-conventions], schemes $X,U$ and an open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Define ordinary completed-coefficient restriction to be the existing exact functor of [def-pur-open-completed-restriction-data], presented on the global completed-module category. Define its strict-tower extension by pointwise postcomposition on $\mathbb N^{op}$ diagrams, with the pointwise additive, finite-limit and finite-colimit structures, and define its exact derived localization on the ordinary derived categories of strict completed-module towers. Name the positive coefficient datum at sequence index $n$ by replacing the level of $P$ by $n+1$, leaving its other data unchanged. These are actual functors and exact localizations, not a choice of lifts of diagrams in the derived category.
